title: THES Book Fair
description: Attention Parents! The highly anticipated THES Fall Book Fair is coming up on November 16–24! It is the perfect opportunity to stock up on new books and fuel your child's love for reading. To…
description_full: Attention Parents! The highly anticipated THES Fall Book Fair is coming up on November 16–24! It is the perfect opportunity to stock up on new books and fuel your child's love for reading. To celebrate, we are kicking off our monthly library challenge to help your child earn free books! Here is how to participate: 1. Snap a photo of your child reading at home, in a cozy spot, or on an adventure. 2. Send the picture to the library: jjordan1@hcpss.org 3. Your child will instantly earn one "Camper Cash" dollar to spend directly at the Book Fair! Mark your calendars for Nov. 16–24, get those cameras ready, and happy reading!

description_full: 🌯 Chipotle Restaurant Night Out – Support Thunder Hill Elementary PTA! Take a break from cooking and support our school! Join us for a delicious Chipotle meal while helping raise funds for Thunder Hill Elementary PTA programs and activities. How to Participate: 1. Order through the Chipotle app or Chipotle.com. 2. Select Pickup at the participating Chipotle location. 3. Add your favorite meals to your order. 4. At checkout, enter the fundraiser code in the “Enter a Promo Code” field and click Apply. 5. Complete your purchase and pick up your order during the scheduled fundraiser hours. Important: Online orders must be placed through Chipotle’s app or website. Delivery orders and third-party apps do not qualify. Your cart will show “Fundraiser -$0.01” when the code is successfully applied. ❤️ Every qualifying order helps support our students, teachers, and school community! Thank you for supporting THES PTA!

title: GIVING TUESDAY – GIVE A LITTLE. MAKE A BIG DIFFERENCE!
description: 💙💛 GIVING TUESDAY – GIVE A LITTLE. MAKE A BIG DIFFERENCE! 💛💙 What does THES PTA do? We help create the experiences and memories that make elementary school special! From the excitement of Fall Fest…
description_full: 💙💛 GIVING TUESDAY – GIVE A LITTLE. MAKE A BIG DIFFERENCE! 💛💙 What does THES PTA do? We help create the experiences and memories that make elementary school special! From the excitement of Fall Fest and Trunk or Treat to the smiles at our Ice Cream Social, the magic of Winter Wonderland, and the celebration of cultures at International Night, THES PTA works throughout the year to bring meaningful experiences to our students and families. Through the support of our school community, we help provide opportunities for children to: 🎃 Celebrate together at Fall Fest & Trunk or Treat 🍦 Enjoy our Welcome Back Ice Cream Social 🇺🇸 Recognize and honor our veterans ❄️ Experience the magic of Winter Wonderland 🌎 Explore cultures and traditions at International Night 🔬 Discover, create, and learn at STEM Night 💼 Explore future possibilities at Career Day 🏃 Build memories and friendships at Field Day 🌱 Celebrate our planet on Earth Day 🌸 Enjoy community fun at Spring Fling 🎉 Celebrate the end of another wonderful school year We also support our incredible teachers and staff through appreciation activities and provide opportunities that enrich the school experience for everyone. These are more than just events. They are opportunities for children to make friends, discover new interests, celebrate their school community, create lasting memories, and feel connected to something special. This Giving Tuesday, Tuesday, December 1, please consider making a donation to the Thunder Hill Elementary School PTA. Every contribution, big or small, helps us continue creating these wonderful experiences for our students, teachers, staff, and families. 💙 Your donation helps create the memories our children will carry with them long after elementary school! Give a Little. Make a BIG Difference! DONATE TODAY: https://1thes.givebacks.com/shop Thank you for supporting THES PTA and our Thunder Hill community!
